{{Quote|My tomb echoes with the footfall of plunderers. Cleanse this hallowed place, and I will grant you power... such power...|Nil Venerous|<ref name="Encounter" />}}

'''Nil Venerous''' was an ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who was entombed in the [[Dark Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] after [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Death/Legends|death]]. His spirit briefly possessed [[Dorian]] when the Temple was opened.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> His disturbed spirit promised power to travelers that ventured into the Dark Temple if they rid it of the possessed plunderers wandering the tombs.<ref name="Encounter" />
